mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event (event_id, event_type, event_key, aggregate_id, partition_key, payload, status) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{eventKey}, #{aggregateId}, #{partitionKey}, #{payload}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_key = VALUES(event_key)
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, event_type, event_key, aggregate_id, partition_key, payload, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, last_error, create_time, locked_by, lock_token, locked_until, published_time, dead_time FROM outbox_event WHERE event_type = 'AWARD_DELIVERY_REQUESTED' AND status = 0 AND next_attempt_at <= NOW() AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until < NOW()) ORDER BY create_time, event_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET locked_by = #{lockedBy}, lock_token = #{lockToken}, locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, update_time = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 0 AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until < NOW())

UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 1, published_time = NOW(), last_error = NULL, locked_by = NULL, lock_token = NULL, locked_until = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 0 AND lock_token = #{lockToken}

UPDATE outbox_event SET attempts = attempts + 1, status = CASE WHEN attempts + 1 >= 10 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END, last_error = #{reason}, next_attempt_at = CASE WHEN attempts + 1 >= 10 THEN next_attempt_at ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL LEAST(3600, POW(2, attempts + 1)) SECOND) END, dead_time = CASE WHEN attempts + 1 >= 10 THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, locked_by = NULL, lock_token = NULL, locked_until = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 0 AND lock_token = #{lockToken}
